pages.summary: Daphne, Tracey y Astoria escuchan las dudas de Hermione y le animan a hablar con Pansy.

panels.scene: Daphne sits on rug at comfortable distance beside Hermione, both fully dressed. Tracey and Astoria listen on chairs. Warm fire and cool arched window, two sleeping cribs distant.
dialogue: Daphne: Eres parte de este grupo, Hermione.

panels.scene: Hermione looks at her own hands, chestnut curls, gentle uncertain brown eyes, white platinum pendant. Two natural hands.
dialogue: Hermione: Con Pansy, a veces me da miedo no saber qué decir.

panels.scene: Astoria blue-gray eyes, long brown waves, sits upright in green chair. Hermione in left foreground.
dialogue: Astoria: Hablen de lo que sienten y de lo que esperan.

panels.scene: Tracey high ponytail smiles encouragingly. Green uniform, hands relaxed in lap. Fireplace behind.
dialogue: Tracey: Está bien tener miedo. También pueden tomarse su tiempo.

panels.scene: Hermione lets out a quiet relieved smile. Daphne looks at her warmly. All seated, ordinary conversation.
dialogue: Hermione: ¿Y si no sé cómo empezar?
Daphne: Empieza por lo que sientes.

panels.scene: Small gold magic sparkle beside green chair as adult elf Nodky's pointed ears peek around the armrest. Hermione turns toward him delighted. Stable room and no new people.
dialogue: Hermione: ¡Nodky!

pages.summary: Nodky trae la capa de Harry y se ofrece a cuidar de Robin mientras el grupo sale.

panels.scene: Nodky walks around armchair carrying a wrapped parcel and two small closed wooden cases. Short adult elf, brown hair and beige clothes. Hermione takes a case.
dialogue: Nodky: Traje el paquete de la señorita Ginny.

panels.scene: Nodky smiles proudly beside low table while Hermione opens wrapping. No open bottles, objects stay closed.
dialogue: Nodky: ¡Hasta me dio un bocadillo de melaza!

panels.scene: A folded silver gray shimmering fabric lies across the closed box on table. Daphne and Astoria lean forward to look, entirely dressed in normal clothes.
dialogue: Daphne: ¿Qué es eso?

panels.scene: Hermione lifts one corner of smooth silver cloth, long chestnut curls, calm mischievous smile and full uniform. Cloth drapes naturally, no disappearing bodies yet.

panels.scene: Hermione turns to Nodky, holds folded cloak with one hand, gestures softly toward one sleeping Robin in moon-star crib. The second crib with Arianna stays separate farther back.
dialogue: Hermione: ¿Puedes cuidar a Robin un rato?

panels.scene: Nodky salutes solemnly at the crib, smiling proudly. Robin safely asleep, hands under cream blanket, small brown forelock, no toys in crib.
dialogue: Nodky: ¡Puede contar conmigo!

pages.summary: Hermione explica el plan. Pansy viaja con ella bajo la capa y Blaise se queda con Nodky.

panels.scene: Hermione explains to the three friends near folded cloak on table. Daphne blonde, Tracey ponytail, Astoria dark long hair, all fully dressed.
dialogue: Hermione: Tenemos que averiguar qué prepara Diane.

panels.scene: Blaise enters through oak door cradling one dark green-eyed Puffskein, no child in his arms. He looks at folded cloak skeptically.
dialogue: Blaise: ¿Y cómo cruzarán el castillo sin que las vean?

panels.scene: Hermione raises silver cloak to her shoulders, then show a single translucent full human silhouette with the stone room visible through it. Friends startled, no missing body parts.
panels.caption: La respuesta de Hermione fue ponerse la capa.

panels.scene: Hermione lowers cloak hood and is fully visible again. Takes one little Puffskein securely in both hands, green eyes looking up. Warm faces and intact anatomy.
dialogue: Hermione: Tú vienes conmigo.

panels.scene: Blaise in green uniform watches over the separate sleeping infants with adult elf Nodky. Same two moon-star cribs and warm bedroom, both babies supported.
panels.caption: Blaise se quedó con Nodky y los bebés.

panels.scene: Night stone corridor, one big silver-gray cloak around four women with softly translucent entire figures, walking together. Hermione at front holds little charcoal green-eyed Puffskein. No extra people.
panels.caption: Diez minutos después, el plan estaba en marcha.

pages.summary: El grupo se acerca a la enfermería. Diane oye un susurro y busca a quien se esconde.

panels.scene: Wide quiet infirmary, Diane seated reading in near bed, Katie asleep in farther bed, restored face. Four translucent full figures under single silver cloak by left entrance, Hermione holding small Puffskein. Only reader sees them.
panels.caption: La enfermería estaba casi a oscuras.

panels.scene: Close from inside cloak, Daphne's pale blonde waves and green tie, quiet amused whisper. Hermione signals calm with one open palm, Puffskein resting against arm.
dialogue: Daphne: Qué nivel de drama.

panels.scene: Diane turns toward dark aisle and lowers book, eyes alert, fully opaque cardigan, no injury drawn. Katie still asleep behind.
dialogue: Diane: ¿Quién está ahí?

panels.scene: Diane points her wand toward empty curtain. A small pale blue light, no effect on cloak. The four wait under cloak at far edge.
dialogue: Diane: ¡Accio!

panels.scene: Low wide view of bedside curtain. Diane rises and looks toward the cream fabric as it rustles. A tiny separate gray mouse-shaped magical decoy hides near its hem, far from anyone. No scary teeth.
panels.caption: Un ruido junto a la cortina desvió su atención.

panels.scene: Diane opens the curtain and a tiny gray magical mouse darts out away from people. Her surprised expression and the other students moving silently toward oak office door under cloak.
panels.caption: Hermione aprovechó el instante.

pages.summary: Después de la ronda de Pomfrey, Hermione se muestra ante Diane y Katie.

panels.scene: At oak nurse office door, Hermione under a pale silver cloak gestures quietly to the three friends, tiny Puffskein in Tracey’s arms under cloak. The gray decoy mouse vanishes into faint gold sparks near distant curtain.
dialogue: Hermione: Vigilen la puerta.

panels.scene: Adult nurse Pomfrey in white cap and full burgundy long dress with apron enters oak office, looking at a closed ledger. Hermione waits out of her sight behind the side of wooden desk. No objects touched.
panels.caption: Pomfrey regresó a su despacho.

panels.scene: Nurse Pomfrey passes two quiet beds, checks her clipboard, then exits through oak door. Diane and Katie in full white opaque cardigan, hands resting on blanket. No medical procedures.
panels.caption: Las cuatro esperaron a que terminara la ronda.

dialogue: Hermione: Brennan, creo que el naranja no es tu color.

panels.scene: Diane reaches toward empty bedside table and looks confused. Astoria across aisle holds two plain wooden wands at her own side. Daphne and Tracey step out of cloak.
dialogue: Diane: ¿Vienes por un segundo asalto?

panels.scene: Hermione at a comfortable distance from Diane’s bed, wand lowered and palms relaxed. Tracey and Astoria at side, one small green-eyed Puffskein in Tracey’s arms.

panels.scene: Astoria beside cream curtain turns to Diane, long dark brown waves and blue-gray eyes. Diane sits upright in ivory cardigan.
